title: IDProxy: CTR Prediction with Multimodal LLMs for Cold-Start Recommendation at Xiaohongshu
abstract: arXiv:2603.01590v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Content-driven platforms such as Xiaohongshu often leverage click-through rate (CTR) prediction models for recommendation. However, these models depend heavily on item ID embeddings, which perform poorly in item cold-start settings. In this paper, we present IDProxy, a production-scale system developed at Xiaohongshu to address this challenge. IDProxy leverages multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to generate proxy embeddings from rich content signals, enabling CTR prediction for new items in the absence of usage data. Through a lightweight coarse-to-fine mechanism, these proxies are aligned with the ID embedding space and trained end-to-end with the ranking model, allowing seamless integration into production-facing pipelines. translated_title: IDProxy：基于多模态大语言模型的小红书冷启动推荐CTR预测
translated_abstract: 像小红书这样的内容驱动平台通常利用点击率（CTR）预测模型进行推荐。然而，这些模型严重依赖物品ID嵌入，而ID嵌入在物品冷启动场景下表现不佳。在本文中，我们提出了IDProxy，这是小红书开发的用于解决这一挑战的生产级系统。IDProxy利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）从丰富的内容信号中生成代理嵌入，使得在缺乏使用数据的情况下也能对新物品进行CTR预测。通过一个轻量级的由粗到细机制，这些代理嵌入与ID嵌入空间对齐，并与排序模型进行端到端训练，从而能够无缝集成到生产流水线中。大量的离线和在线实验证明了该方法的有效性，该方法已于2025年部署在小红书的内容流和展示广告功能中，覆盖数亿用户。
tldr: 小红书提出IDProxy系统，利用多模态大语言模型从内容信号生成代理嵌入并与ID嵌入空间对齐进行端到端训练，解决了新物品冷启动场景下的CTR预测难题，已部署于生产环境服务数亿用户。
en_tdlr: Xiaohongshu's IDProxy system leverages multimodal LLMs to generate proxy embeddings from content signals, aligned with the ID embedding space through a lightweight coarse-to-fine mechanism and trained end-to-end, enabling effective CTR prediction for cold-start items in production serving hundreds of millions of users.
